title: Seven Mohan Babu University Faculty Named in Stanford–Elsevier World's Top 2% Scientists List
summary: The Tirupati university features on the list for the fourth consecutive year, with faculty from engineering, mathematical sciences, biological and chemical engineering and data science.
body_html:
Tirupati, 13 October 2026: Seven faculty members of Mohan Babu University (MBU) have been named in the World's Top 2% Scientists List compiled by Stanford University with Elsevier. It is the fourth consecutive year that the university is represented on the list.

The list ranks researchers on standardised citation-based indicators, with separate assessments of research impact in a single year and across a researcher's career.

In the Single-Year category, the list includes Prof. D. Karunanidhi, Deputy Dean, Civil Engineering; Dr. K. Venkatadri, Assistant Professor, Mathematical Sciences; Dr. M. Arokia Vijaya Anand, Assistant Professor, Biological and Chemical Engineering; Dr. K. Reddy Madhavi, Professor and Head, Data Science; Dr. P. Thejasree, Associate Professor, Mechanical Engineering; and Dr. Manikandan Natarajan, Professor, Mechanical Engineering.

In the Career-Long category, Prof. Avireni Srinivasulu, Dean, Electronics and Communication Engineering, has been recognised for his sustained research contributions.

"It is a matter of pride to see our faculty recognised once again for their research excellence and global contributions," said Vinay Maheshwari, Executive Director, Mohan Babu University.

The university, located in Tirupati, Andhra Pradesh, has more than 30 research laboratories, the V-Hub Innovation Centre and an AICTE-IDEA Lab, and reports over 250 patents.
